Which identifier is the authoritative master-system identifier for this jurisdiction, and which body issues it?
If no master-system identifier exists, which governed global URI is used, and on what basis is a locally minted ULID or UUID justified instead?
How is an identifier retired so that it is never renamed or reassigned to a different jurisdiction?
Which alternate names, historical names and transliterations are recorded, and which one is authoritative for display?
Which external code schemes are aligned to this jurisdiction, and what code value applies in each?
Is each alignment exact, broader, narrower or merely related, and what evidence supports that judgement?
Does any aligned scheme carry a published caveat that its groupings imply no position on legal or political status?
How are code changes, splits and withdrawals by the maintenance agency detected and reflected without altering the local identifier?
Which typology value applies to this jurisdiction and what evidence selects that value rather than a neighbouring one?
Can a single jurisdiction hold more than one typology value at once, and how is that recorded without ambiguity?
Is the jurisdiction functional and partial rather than plenary, covering only enumerated activities within an area?
Who may extend the typology code list, and how are additions reviewed against primary sources?
Which types of power does this jurisdiction assert: to prescribe rules, to adjudicate claims, or to enforce outcomes?
Where prescriptive reach exceeds enforceable reach, how is that asymmetry recorded rather than smoothed over?
Which referenced model owns the actual evaluation, decision and enforcement execution that this classification merely describes?
Where a non-resident actor must appoint a local representative or agent for service, which instrument imposes that and what is recorded here?
Which authority holds this competence, and in which external register is that authority mastered?
Where several bodies share the same scope, how is each body's distinct share recorded?
When the holding authority is reorganised, renamed or abolished, what happens to the jurisdiction record's identifier?
Which instrument confers this competence, and by which governed legal identifier is it cited?
Which specific provision within the instrument carries the conferral, and how is that pinpoint citation expressed?
Where competence is conferred through a chain of instruments, how is the chain ordered and its weakest link identified?
Which instrument attributes are deliberately not stored here because the legislation model owns them?
Into which competence category does this scope fall, and what does that category permit other authorities to do?
Which subject matters are reserved to this jurisdiction exclusively, so that no other forum may hear them?
Where competence is shared, at what point does exercise by the higher authority pre-empt the lower one?
How is the principle of conferral recorded, so that competence not expressly conferred is not inferred?
Which instrument effects the delegation or devolution, and is the transfer revocable by the delegating authority?
What competence does the delegating authority retain, including oversight, direction and substitution rights?
May the delegate sub-delegate, and if so within what limits?
Where competence is created or narrowed by party agreement rather than by public conferral, how is that consensual basis recorded?
Which administrative unit or boundary features in the spatial model delimit this jurisdiction's land territory?
Which jurisdictions nest inside this one and which does it nest within, and is the nesting exhaustive without gaps?
Does the territory include enclaves, exclaves, condominia or areas of shared administration, and how is each recorded?
Which spatial attributes are deliberately excluded here because the spatial model masters them?
Which maritime or aerial zone type does this record cover, and what is its outer limit measured from which baseline?
What specific rights and jurisdiction does the authority hold in this zone, as distinct from full sovereignty?
Which freedoms or passage rights do other States retain within this zone, and under what conditions?
Which charts or lists of geographical coordinates were deposited, with which depositary, and on what date?
On which connecting factor does the extraterritorial assertion rest: establishment, conduct, effect, targeting, nationality, protective interest or universality?
Where reach depends on targeting or monitoring of persons in the territory, what indicators evidence that targeting?
What limits on giving the assertion practical effect are recorded, and which model owns any action taken about them?
Has the assertion been contested by another authority, and where is that contestation recorded?
Which classes of natural and legal persons are within scope, and which are expressly excluded?
Which attachment criteria apply — domicile, habitual residence, nationality, statutory seat, central administration or principal place of business — and in what priority order?
Which weaker-party or protected categories receive special attachment rules that displace the general rule?
Where are the underlying person and entity attributes mastered, and what is consumed here by reference only?
Which subject matters fall within this competence, and by which classification scheme are they named?
Which matters are expressly excluded from scope, and does an exclusion in one instrument imply competence elsewhere?
Do any gravity, value or seriousness thresholds condition the competence over a covered matter?
How is a change to the subject-matter catalogue tied to the amending instrument and its effective date?
When did the competence enter into force and from which instant does it apply to conduct or proceedings?
Does the competence reach conduct occurring before entry into force, and under which express declaration if so?
Is there a sunset, expiry or termination instant, and what happens to matters already pending at that instant?
How are the effective instant of a change and the instant this model observed it kept as separate fields?
Which jurisdictions stand above and below this one, and on what instrument does the ordering rest?
On direct conflict of norms, which order prevails and within what limits?
Under what conditions must this jurisdiction defer to another that is genuinely investigating or deciding the same matter?
Which jurisdiction reviews decisions of this one, and is that review reference or ownership?
Is the relation to the other jurisdiction exclusive, concurrent, hierarchical or disputed at the reference instant?
Which recorded rule assigns priority when both competences would otherwise apply?
Where proceedings on the same cause are already pending elsewhere, what is the recorded consequence for this jurisdiction?
Where two competences overlap only partially, how is the intersection scoped along the four axes?
Which instrument designates this jurisdiction as a chosen forum, and is that designation exclusive?
What obligations follow for the chosen court and for other courts under the governing convention?
On which enumerated grounds may recognition or enforcement of a decision from this jurisdiction be refused elsewhere?
How is the record kept clear that designating a forum does not determine the applicable law?
Which exception type applies — immunity, privilege, reservation, declaration, opt-out or derogation — and who benefits from it?
How may the benefit be waived, and does submitting to proceedings amount to waiver for related matters?
Which enumerated exceptions defeat the immunity, such as commercial transactions, employment contracts or immovable property?
Where was the declaration or reservation lodged, with which depositary, and is it still in force?
Is there an overriding mandatory provision or public-policy reservation that displaces an otherwise applicable rule?
Which change type occurred — establishment, extension, reduction, transfer, cession, merger, split, suspension or termination — and which instrument effected it?
What record states exist between draft and terminated, and which transitions are permitted?
Which predecessor and successor jurisdictions are linked, and what proportion of scope passed to each?
What happens to matters and obligations pending at the moment of the change?
Does the change require a new identifier or preserve the existing one, and on what rule does that turn?
Which official publication or register attests each assertion, and at what citation precision?
What authority tier does the source hold, and is it primary or secondary for this assertion?
When was the source retrieved and by which actor or process, and what was its version at that instant?
Which assertions are derived rather than attested, and what derivation rule produced them?
Which authorities assert incompatible competence over the same scope, and what does each assert?
What is the recorded status of the contestation and before which body, if any, is it pending?
How does the record avoid implying a position on legal status while still being usable by an agent?
How must a consuming system behave when a query returns competing claims rather than a single answer?
Which validation rules must a record pass before it may move from draft to published?
For each external standard cited, is conformance claimed, and what evidence would be required to claim it?
How recently was each record reverified against its sources, and what staleness threshold triggers reverification?
What happens to a published record whose source has changed or whose validation now fails?
Which external schemes carry a token for this jurisdiction, and what is the token value in each?
Is each mapping exact, broader, narrower or related, and how are one-to-many mappings represented?
Where two schemes disagree about the same jurisdiction, how is the conflict recorded rather than silently resolved?
How are crosswalk entries invalidated when an external registrar retires or obsoletes a token?
What syntax constrains the jurisdiction token in each compound identifier, including subdivision separators and hierarchy depth?
Who registers and maintains the jurisdiction token for a given scheme, and under what review policy?
Which rules forbid renaming or reassigning a token, and how is obsolescence expressed instead?
How are international organisations and bodies without a territorial code accommodated in these schemes?
Which facts must be supplied to obtain a candidate set, and which are optional refinements?
What does a candidate set contain, and how is the basis of connection reported for each candidate?
What must the procedure refuse to do, and which model owns those refused operations?
How does the procedure signal that inputs are insufficient or that the answer is genuinely contested?
Which fields must the bootstrap descriptor carry for an agent to operate the model without prior knowledge?
In what order must an agent read the bootstrap targets, and what must it do if one is unreachable?
How does the descriptor stay valid across storage projections such as document store, graph, repository or service interface?
How is the descriptor versioned so an agent can detect that the contract has changed?
What is the default access posture for jurisdiction records, and on what public-publication rationale does it rest?
Which records or fields require restriction, such as unpublished drafts or security-sensitive coordinate deposits?
Which categories of personal data are excluded from this model by design, and where do they belong instead?
What access evidence must be produced, and which system owns the audit trail that records it?
Which retention class applies to each record type, and what minimum retention period does it impose?
What must a tombstone preserve when a record is withdrawn, so that historical citations still resolve?
Which policy and which actor own the execution of physical disposition, given that it lies outside this model's boundary?
Are superseded versions retained indefinitely for legal-history reconstruction, and under what exception may they be removed?

requirements: Run a separate no-tools adversarial audit of the active provider result.
Verify the model boundary and entry kind against the frozen relationship contract.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Expose the owner-authorized provider waiver in every publication artifact.
Keep the result reviewable-draft while independent second-provider review is waived.
